# SecOpsNews

> A dashboard of security news, government advisories, breach notices and cloud provider outages, gathered from RSS feeds and updated twice a day. Made for engineering leaders and security professionals by thechelsuk (https://thechels.uk).

Last updated: {{ site.data.news.generated }}

Key facts:

- Sources include The Hacker News, BleepingComputer, SecurityWeek, The Register, CISA, NCSC, NHS Digital, Full Disclosure, Have I Been Pwned, Krebs on Security, Troy Hunt and the status pages of Cloudflare, Google Cloud, AWS, GitHub, Slack and 1Password
- Every headline links to the original article; SecOpsNews doesn't republish content
- Items in the last 24 hours: {{ site.data.news.counts.last_24h }}; flagged critical: {{ site.data.news.counts.critical }}

## Links

- [Dashboard]({{ "/" | absolute_url }}): headlines, advisories and breaches, blogs, and outages
- [RSS feed]({{ "/feed.rss" | absolute_url }}): the daily rundown
- [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/SecOpsNews/news): how the feeds are collected
- [Sponsor SecOpsNews]({{ "/sponsor/" | absolute_url }}): open monthly slots, how to book and sponsorship terms
- Contact: secops@thechels.uk
